listings.title: Manchester United Quote Poster, They Always Score, Barcelona 1999 Treble Print, Man Utd Gift for Dad
listings.description:
Can Manchester United score? They always score.

That's the line from Barcelona, 26 May 1999. Manchester United went into added time of the Champions League final a goal down and won it 2-1, both goals from corners, to finish the treble. This poster sets the words in heavy type on Old Trafford red with the place and the date, and nothing else.

It's for the fan who still talks about that night: a dad, a partner, a mate with a birthday coming, a man cave or a home bar.
listings.alt_mockup: Framed red poster on a plain wall. Heavy cream type reads: Can Manchester United score? They always score. Barcelona 99, treble winners, 26 May 1999.
listings.alt_flat: Red typographic poster with cream lettering: Can Manchester United score? They always score. Barcelona 99 and treble winners at the top, 26.05.1999 at the foot.

listings.title: Manchester United Quote Poster, Seagulls and Trawler Print, 1995 Football Wall Art, Man Utd Gift
listings.description:
When the seagulls follow the trawler, it's because they think sardines will be thrown into the sea.

Said to a room full of reporters on 31 March 1995, and quoted by Manchester United fans ever since. Nobody's sure what it means, which is half the point. This poster sets it in heavy cream type on navy with the date, and nothing else.

It's for the fan who knows the line by heart: a dad, a partner, a mate, a man cave, a study or a home bar.
listings.alt_mockup: Framed navy poster on a plain wall. Cream type reads: When the seagulls follow the trawler, it's because they think sardines will be thrown into the sea. 31 March 1995.
listings.alt_flat: Navy typographic poster with cream lettering: When the seagulls follow the trawler, it's because they think sardines will be thrown into the sea. Manchester at the top, 31.03.1995 at the foot.

listings.title: Manchester United Quote Poster, Only the Best Would Be Good Enough, Old Trafford Print, Man Utd Gift
listings.description:
I never wanted Manchester United to be second to anybody. Only the best would be good enough.

The standard Old Trafford was built on, in the words of the manager who rebuilt the club after the war. This poster sets it in heavy cream type on Old Trafford red, the second line big enough to read from across the room.

It's for the fan who measures every season against it: a dad, a grandad, an office wall, a man cave.
listings.alt_mockup: Framed red poster on a plain wall. Cream type reads: I never wanted Manchester United to be second to anybody. Only the best would be good enough. Old Trafford, Manchester.
listings.alt_flat: Red typographic poster with cream lettering: I never wanted Manchester United to be second to anybody, in smaller type, then Only the best would be good enough in large type. Old Trafford at the top.

listings.title: Manchester United Kids Room Poster, If You're Good Enough You're Old Enough, Boys Football Bedroom Print
listings.description:
If you're good enough, you're old enough.

It's the idea Manchester United have trusted their young players with for generations, and it's a good one to grow up under. This poster sets it in big navy type on cream over the faint lines of a pitch, so it suits a bedroom as well as a football fan.

It's for the parent decorating a young fan's room, or the grandparent buying a first Manchester United present. Parents who don't follow football still get it.
listings.alt_mockup: Framed cream poster on a plain wall. Big navy type over faint pitch lines reads: If you're good enough, you're old enough. Manchester United, since 1878.
listings.alt_flat: Cream typographic poster with navy lettering over faint pitch markings: If you're good enough, you're old enough. Manchester United, since 1878, at the top.

listings.title: Manchester United Kids Room Poster, Glory Glory Man United Print, Football Bedroom Wall Art, Man Utd Gift
listings.description:
Glory glory Man United.

The song the Stretford End has sung for generations, in letters big enough for a bedroom wall. Old Trafford red on cream, over the faint lines of a pitch.

It's for the young fan who already knows the words, and for the parent or grandparent putting their first Manchester United room together.
